settings.help: When true, install ECM (External Custom Music, an ASI plugin) into `SCRIPTS/` and let the player drop tracks into `~/.strom/need-for-speed-underground-2/SCRIPTS/Music/` at runtime. The drop directory is the overlay UPPER, so files there merge with the build-time `extraSoundtracks` (shipped as a separate overlay lower) and become visible to ECM without a rebuild. Supported formats per ECM: wav, mp1, mp2, mp3, ogg, aif. F11 in-game toggles the ECM overlay (volume / skip / playlist).
settings.label: Enable player soundtracks

description: Need for Speed: Underground 2 (via Proton and gamescope)
long: Need for Speed: Underground 2 (2004) is an arcade street-racing game centered on the import tuner scene. It introduced a free-roaming open city where players explore to find races, shops, and events. Deep visual and performance car customization is a core feature of the game.
name: Need for Speed: Underground 2
